native button owns activation, form type, disabled and click semantics; the library adds no controller

evidence.structural-contract: pass: ESM/types and packed isolated consumer resolve; core release policy unchanged
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: pointer/Enter/Space/programmatic activation, disabled suppression, reactive variant/slot, native form submit/reset and repeated remount
evidence.accessibility: pass: accessible labels, native keyboard/focus/disabled and active-state contrast guard
evidence.focused-visual: pass: real computed paints for neutral/primary/text; sizes 40/32/26; icon-only 40/32; no new stylesheet
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Vue form owns counter, submit count, disabled state and mount lifecycle; server DOM retained during hydration
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: 180px long-label container and 320px viewport; leading/trailing and icon-only content

staticVisual: pass: Computed size matrix and inspected consumer screenshots; screenshots are supplemental only
realInteractionVisual: pass: Browser-created hover/active/focus/disabled paints asserted against Buttons.svg values for each mode
runtimeBehavior: pass: Native event/form/lifecycle and hydration flows in tools/playwright-vue/button.spec.js
